about: Proof manifest (protocol fix round, 2026-11-17). The gate runs every proof under "run" in build-and-test at every tier via scripts/run-proofs.py - registering a proof is adding its name here, never editing checks.yml. A proof whose subject has left the app moves to "retired" with the reason recorded; scripts/check-proof-coverage.py fails the build if any file in tests/proof/ is in neither list, if a listed name does not exist, or if a retired entry carries no reason. Proof files never classify a round's tier (scripts/select-tier.py treats tests/proof/** as ride-along, like drive files).

retired.reason: Needs playwright-core + a Chromium through maintainer-VM-only paths (its header: PLAYWRIGHT_CORE / CHROME_BIN env; it resolves the shots directory's node_modules on the maintainer VM), so it cannot run in CI's build-and-test - proven on PR #107, where it failed with 'playwright-core not resolvable' while the other 37 proofs passed. It passes locally (46/46 checks, 2026-11-17) and stays runnable there on demand; the CSS surfaces it measured are covered in CI by the drive battery. Retired from the gate manifest by the protocol fix round, 2026-11-17.

Beta 1.243: its subject - importDraft, the photo door's draft-import half - is removed from the app with the Upload photo door, so the D-03 defect class it pinned dies with the feature. The file stays on disk as the record, like proof-rerun-css-batch.

Its subject no longer exists: Beta 1.258 (Andrew's decision, 2026-11-20) retired the app's own street titles (streetnamespt1-4 over labelpts) and the 1.248 re-placement helper this proof pinned, and made the basemap's own road labels the street-name system. The retirement's pins live in proof-1258; drive130 grades the rendered rule. Kept on disk as the 1.248 round's record; do not re-add to run.

Beta 1.261 (labelmix-1261): its subject - the 1.258 retirement of the app title system - is reversed by Andrew's decision of 2026-11-20 (the label mix: the titles are restored below zoom 15, capped there, with the basemap full names at 15 and up). Its pins assert the titles' absence and the lane-era basemap shape, so they invert by the decision itself, not by a defect. The file stays on disk as the record of the 1.258 round, like proof-1248 before it; the mix's shape is pinned by proof-1261 and graded in the rendered page by drive214's M sections.

Beta 1.263 (labelrevert-1263): its subject - the 1.261 label mix (titles capped at 15, the '-pre15' band split, the standing heal) - is reversed by Andrew's decision of 2026-11-21 ("We should revert the naming system to before all this"), after the heal's per-settle teardown measured as the street-name flicker (33 of 33 titles dropped at every settle). Its seam, band and heal pins invert by the decision itself, not by a defect. The file stays on disk as the record of the 1.261 round, like proof-1258 before it; the reverted shape is pinned by proof-1263 and graded in the rendered page by drive214's reworked M sections and drive216.

Beta 1.270 (SYNC round): its subject - the 1.266 unified load-in (every name held for the whole window, the one re-place inside the hold, the joint reveal with its two backstops) - is retired by Andrew's synchronised-streaming decision of 2026-11-21, taken on his lived verdict on 1.266 (a nameless wait, then a pop). Its pins assert the hold cycle's presence, so they invert by the decision itself, not by a defect. The file stays on disk as the record of the 1.266 round, like proof-1261 before it; the streaming shape is pinned by proof-1270 and graded in the rendered page by drive219's rewritten lane.
